description: This Java class 'RomChecksum' provides methods for calculating and validating checksums within a ROM image, used for tuning, logging, and reflashing in the RomRaider project.

classes.name: RomChecksum
classes.description: A utility class for checksum calculations and validation in ROM data.

methods.name: calculateRomChecksum
methods.description: Calculates and updates checksums in the input byte array over a specified data range.

methods.name: validateRomChecksum
methods.description: Validates checksums in the input byte array over a specified data range, returning status codes.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Validates individual checksum segments within the input array.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum bytes for a segment of the input array.
